description:
An annotated aerial image in false colour, displaying various land cover/land use (LCLU) types marked with numerical classification codes and outlined boundaries. Healthy vegetation appears in shades of red, while bare earth, buildings, and impervious surfaces appear in grey, white, and dark grey tones.

The image features a large central area, outlined in light blue, showing extensive soil or bedrock excavations, characteristic of a construction site or mineral extraction site. This area is labelled with code 1310.
Surrounding this central feature:
*   To the north, an area of dense red vegetation is labelled with code 3310 (likely Broad-leaved forest).
*   Further north-east, a cluster of dark grey buildings resembling industrial or commercial units is outlined in light blue and labelled with code 1120.
*   An area adjacent to the north-western edge of the 1310 site, showing a mix of built structures and vegetation, is labelled with code 1400 (likely Artificial surfaces such as green urban areas or sport and leisure facilities).
*   To the south-east and partially overlapping with an area labelled 3210 (likely Natural grasslands or transitional woodland-shrub), a residential area with visible roofs is labelled with code 1110 (Continuous urban fabric).

Other labelled features include an area of less dense red vegetation or scrub to the south-east labelled 3210 (likely Natural grasslands or transitional woodland-shrub). A light orange line delineates various parcel boundaries throughout the image.
